review: Reviewed 268 complete logical sheets with 324 unit rows across eight buildings. Divided physical spreads only at their binding gutter, retaining labels, tables, logos, notices and orientation diagrams. Matched extracted totals and titles against OCR of the visible rendered panels, then manually checked the 12 total and 13 title panels where OCR missed or clipped text. Ignored stale hidden area rows beneath the visible PDF artwork. Used the brochure drive times and map as a consistent community-scoped set.
unavailable: Exact building entrance coordinates were unavailable. Directions use the project name.
